services.name: Rainbow Trout and Dolly Varden Char Fishing Charter
services.desc: Alaska Rainbow Trout Fishing Rates Half Day (4 Hours): $900 Full Day (6-8 Hours): $1200 About Rainbow trout and Dolly Varden trout trips are for the sport angler. Trout trips are a trophy hunters dream and a great way to see the river in a chill manner for the more relaxed angler. services.name: Salmon Fishing Charter
services.desc: Alaska Salmon Fishing! Rates Half Day (4 Hours): $900 Full Day (6-8 Hours): $1200 About Salmon fishing is for the person who wants to bring some fish home with them or fish a species they don't get to catch at home. The sockeye limit is usually 3 fish or 6 fish depending on the amount of fish that have entered the river. We fillet all the salmon for you and direct you to a fish processor to vac pack. Half Day Charters are not available June 11 - July 16. We wait until the second run shows up on the Upper River. Included All fishing gear & waders Not Included Fishing license Rain jacket Food & beverage What to bring Warm clothes & socks Ball cap Polarized

services.name: Combo Trip Salmon and Trout
services.desc: Combo Trip Salmon and Trout About Combo trips are for anglers who want to fish both the salmon and trout. We have two start times, the early start time is for people who have salmon as their top priority and the later start time is for people who want trout and char for their priority fish. It's usually more competitive to get salmon spots so the early bird gets the worm. Included All fishing gear & waders Not Included Fishing license Rain jacket Food & beverage What to bring Warm clothes & socks Ball cap Polarized sunglasses Rain
